Md Mutahar Hossain with Md Majedul Quader and Md Raziuddin Sorwar; Advocate -----For the Petitioner. 
Tufailur Rahman with Umme Salma with Afifa Afroze and Rashida Ali, Advocate ----- For the Respondent Nos. 3 and 4.
parties:
Ishakha CNG & Filling Station Limited ------ Petitioner
Vs. 
Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh and others ------ Respondents
full_judgment: 2. It has been stated in the petition, amongst other, that the petitioner is a bonafide citizen of Bangladesh and is the Managing Director of the petitioner company Mis Ishakha CNG and Filling Station, located at village Shalpa Panni Post Office: Gouripur, Police Station: Dawood Kandi, District: Comilla and is engaged in the business of supplying gas as fuel to motor vehicles. The petitioner company is a Private Company Limited by shares and is incorporated under the Companies Act (Act XVIII) of 1994 on the second day of November Two Thousand Six, vide Certificate of Incorporation No. C-65355 (1846)/06. The Company has obtained Trade License dated 20-7-2011, Income Tax Identification Number 385-200- 1089-Cha-Chittagong-1, Comilla-1, VAT Registration Certificate, Chittagong, Comilla Division dated 30-3-2009, NOC from Fire Service and Civil Defence, Comilla for installation of 315 KVA electric sub-station dated 22-3-2008 and permission from the office of Executive Engineer সড়ক বিভাগ, কুমিল্লা, dated 18-10-2006, for construction of service road towards the station along with receipts of payments made in favour of the office of the executive engineer permission to set up CNG Filling Station accorded by Rupantarita Prakritik Gas Company Ltd (A copy of Petrobangla), permission vide Ref. 6-3-09 (Part-1297- STN)08 dated 28-12-2006. No Objection from Deputy Commissioner, District, Comilla vide ref. 14-11/2006-2751/J.M dated 20-9-2006, License (Certificate No. CNG-0268) issued by Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission, Government of Bangladesh dated 27-10-2009, Import registration License, Letter from Comilla Palli Bidyut Samity, dated 08-10-2007 certificate from the Directorate of Environment dated 18-10-2011 (renewed) vide letter No. PAW/Fu: Je: Fa:/Char potra/377/2011/522, Import Registration, License from Chief Explosive Inspector dated 15-6-2008, required for separating such business for supplying gas as fuel to motor vehicles. That Petrobangla is fully controlled by the Government as it was established under Bangladesh Oil, Gas and Mineral Corporation Ordinance 1985. Its Chairman and Directors are appointed by the Government, the respondent No.3 is a subsidiary of Petrobangla and it is also managed and controlled by the government through Petrobangla. Under Article 143 of the Constitution natural gas belongs to the government and the respondent No. 2 has been given power and authority to deal with the natural gas. So it is a person performing functions concerned with the affairs of the Republic; that after fulfilling all requirements the petitioner company has obtained permission from the respondents to supply gas to the petitioner company; after getting the project established it has started getting supply of it from the respondents to the gas purchaser since-2008, that a letter has been issued contained in Memo No.জ্বালানি (অপা-১)/পিবি৭/৭/২৫৬ dated 4-5-2008 under the signature of the respondent No.1 with mandatory direction upon the every CNG Filling station to set up generator within 8 (eight) months from date; that after obtaining permission from the respondents, the petitioner complied with all the requirements and deposited all the necessary fees, demands and securities; that to comply with the direction of respondent No.1, the petitioner company sent a message to Jaksons Limited (100% EOU) for purchasing various equipment for setting up generator to the Filling Station and accordingly the petitioner company received a proforma Invoice No. JL/E/IKCNG/PHEN/PH61/09 dated 3-3-2009 with total cost of US$ 68,000 and thereafter the petitioner company received a message hard-copy on 10-6-2009 from the contracting Jacksons Limited with confirmation that all the contracting equipment have been sent to the petitioner thereafter the petitioner company received all the machineries according to contract, that the petitioner imported various tools to set up generator to the CNG Station and the respondent No.3 permitted the petitioner in opening a গ্রাহকসংকেতনং১৯-০০৫ in connection with installation of generator and issued a demand note to deposit Taka 2,86,786.00 and another demand note to deposit Taka 19,908, both dated 15-11-2009 and a 3rd demand note dated 23-11-2009 to pay Taka 4076 the petitioner paid all the demands of the respondents in connection with the installation of generator through separate receipts from 18-10-2008 to 17-10-2012; that only works remain to be done to operate the generator during the failure of power supply, are to set up a motor and gas supply to the generator, but it is a matter of great regret that the respondents miserably failed to accord permission to set up meter and gas connection to the already installed imported generator, that despite repeated requests the respondents did not take any initiative so far; that the petitioner presented a letter dated 5-5-2010 to the Chairman but found no response yet; that the petitioner lastly wrote a letter addressing the respondent No.3, on 11-6-2012, detailing all facts in connection with the installation of Meter and gas connection to generator and the said letter was duly received by the office of the respondent No.3 on 11-6-2012, but the respondents did not pay any attention to the petitioner. Hence, this petition.
